scope: Selected numerical manuscript claims with explicit current source bindings, plus two supporting consistency checks. Does not certify all numerical occurrences in the manuscript or the qualitative/Lean claims. Expectations are explicit reported claims; computed values are independently aggregated from identified records. Fresh field-derived records are preferred when supplied, while N5 remains labelled as a frozen-summary check unless a fresh N5 CSV is supplied.
